history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A lone soldier in full camouflage uniform, including a helmet with "712" inscribed on it, stands resolutely. They are equipped with a tactical vest, also marked with "712," and hold a rifle in a ready position. The soldier's face is obscured by a black balaclava and tactical goggles. In the background, a large, majestic statue of an eagle with spread wings, reminiscent of the Garuda Pancasila symbol, stands prominently against a lush, mountainous landscape. A black banner with bold, red lettering, partially visible as "APUNU," stretches across the mid-ground. The lighting is natural, suggesting an overcast or early morning/late afternoon setting, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the uniform and the natural environment. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones of green, brown, and black from the camouflage, contrasted with the golden hues of the eagle statue and the vibrant red of the banner. The overall mood is one of strength, vigilance, and national pride.
